# Aktualino partition table — classic ES: #   - No `factory` partition: we boot straight into an OTA slot so both A and B
#     are updatable. otadata selects the active slot and drives rollback.
#   - Two equal app slots (ota_0 / ota_1) at ~1.5 MB each — comfortable for an
#     ESP-IDF monolithic app with mbedTLS + libsodium + cJSON.
#   - nvs: device identity / TUF metadata / install state (encrypted NVS later).
# App (ota_*) partitions must be aligned to 0x10000 (64 KB).
# End of ota_1: 0x320000 — leaves ~0xE0000 (896 KB) headroom under 0x400000 (4 MB).
